mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_source WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM data_source ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_source (id, name, db_type, host, port, database_name, username, password_encrypted, status, created_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, gen_random_uuid()), #{name}, #{dbType}, #{host}, #{port}, #{databaseName}, #{username}, #{passwordEncrypted}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE data_source SET name = #{name}, db_type = #{dbType}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, database_name = #{databaseName}, username = #{username}, password_encrypted = #{passwordEncrypted}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM data_source WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
